feature: Prototype pollution via JSON body (__proto__/constructor)
NoSQL/SQL-style injection strings in search/query/body
expected: treated as plain text, no errors, no extra rows

feature: Stored XSS payloads are returned as inert JSON data (server side)
actual: payload stored verbatim; output encoding is the client's job
evidence: Browser rendering (React escaping) NOT executed here → client-side XSS unverified

feature: Security headers present (CSP, nosniff, frame, referrer, HSTS on https, no-store on /api)
evidence: CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

feature: CORS: foreign origin blocked, same-origin + allow-list allowed, null/invalid origin rejected, no credentials header
actual: evil=403 same=true allow=true invalid=403 null=403 preflightEvil=403

feature: SSRF validator: 30 bypass attempts all rejected
SSRF validator accepts normal public hosts
DNS-rebinding style hosts (names resolving to loopback/private) blocked at connect time
actual: localhost -> Blocked: private address; localtest.me (public name that resolves to 127.0.0.1) -> getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND localtest.me
evidence: no outbound DNS in sandbox: only the localhost case is conclusive; localtest.me result depends on resolver availability

feature: Rate limiting: auth endpoints 429 with Retry-After after limit; per-IP isolation
Rate limiting: general API limiter and AI/probe limiters trigger
Account lockout: 5 bad attempts lock account (and cannot be bypassed with correct pw during lock)
evidence: DESIGN RISK (see SEC-012): the same lock lets an attacker lock a victim out

feature: Account-lockout denial of service: attacker can lock out a known email from any IP
evidence: lock is per-account only (15 min); no per-IP component so the legitimate user is blocked

feature: Login timing: unknown vs known email (user-enumeration via timing)
Registration enumerates existing emails (409)
actual: 409 "An account with this email already exists"
evidence: Reveals which emails have accounts (common trade-off; mitigated only by auth rate limit)

feature: Token integrity: tampered payload, wrong secret, alg-none style, truncated, replay across user
Cross-user token reuse: token for user X cannot act as org Y even with edited org claim
evidence: even a token signed with the real secret is rejected if org does not match the stored user

feature: No secrets in responses or logs during normal operations
actual: webhook secret shown once only; nothing sensitive in list/export/audit/logs

feature: Secret redaction on adversarial strings (JSON, headers, prose, nested)
Upload hardening: path traversal in names, double extension, null byte, header injection in filename
actual: all 6 names sanitised; stored names are server-generated

feature: Uploads are not publicly reachable and are tenant-private; download requires auth
Password hashing: scrypt unique salts, constant-time verify, wrong password rejected
Request body size limit (1MB JSON, 9MB uploads)
actual: NOT EXECUTED: limits are enforced by express.json(), which is replaced by a shim in this sandbox

feature: Session protection in browser (storage of token, XSS exposure, cookie flags)
actual: NOT EXECUTED: no browser. Static fact: token kept in sessionStorage (src/services/api.ts), no cookies used, so CSRF is not applicable but XSS would expose the token

feature: Password policy: reuse of current password allowed on change
Unicode/case email normalisation: look-alike duplicate accounts
Atomic persistence: 40 random SIGKILLs during continuous saves never corrupt the database
evidence: orders at reload ranged 35..233 (loss limited to the last uncommitted write)

feature: Disk/DB write failure: API returns error AND in-memory state stays consistent with disk
expected: failed write is not visible afterwards
actual: response=500; ghost item visible in memory after the failed request=true; persisted later by unrelated save=true
evidence: mutate-then-save without rollback: a request that returned 500 still changed live state, and a later successful save persisted it (phantom write).

feature: DB file corrupted while running → next restart refuses (fail-closed), prev copy available
evidence: recovery is manual (restore database.prev.json); there is no automatic fallback or alert

feature: Webhook endpoint hangs forever: user request unaffected, no unbounded growth beyond pending tasks
evidence: the injected transport never resolves; production safePost has a 5s socket timeout (FAIL-005 covers it)

feature: Real safePost/safeGet to an unreachable/blocked/slow endpoint resolve (no hang)
actual: both resolved failed in 4ms: "Blocked: private address" / "Blocked: private address"

feature: Webhook retry exhaustion is logged; 4xx not retried; later events still flow
Discovery probe upstream failure/exception handled
evidence: Observation: an upstream exception becomes a generic 500 rather than a 502 with a user-meaningful message

feature: Unhandled exception in a route yields generic 500, no stack/internal paths
Gateway verifier throws/hangs during verify: transaction not upgraded, retry possible
expected: org stays FREE; tx still PENDING
actual: 500, tx after failed verify=PENDING, tier=FREE, retry=200

feature: Failed background job: retries do not duplicate user-visible side effects; duplicate event ids unique
actual: 3 attempts share one event id (receiver can de-duplicate): true
